items.name: Nepali Nationals 2019

venue.name: [Adarsha Vidya Mandir](http://www.avm.edu.np/)
venue.address: Adarsha Vidya Mandir, Manbhawan, Lalitpur, Nepal
venue.details: Main Hall, Second Floor, High School Section

items.information: This competition is the fourth iteration of the Nepali National Championship and is open to competitors of all nationalities. However, only Nepalese participants will be eligible for prizes and titles. यो प्रतियोगिता नेपाली राष्ट्रिय प्रतिस्पर्धाको चौथो शृङ्खला हो र यो सबै राष्ट्रियताको प्रतियोगीका लागि खुला छ। तर उपाधि तथा पुरस्कार प्राप्त गर्न नेपाली प्रतियोगी मात्रै योग्य हुने छन्।
